bull.last: LITE: argues long. Lumentum Holdings Inc. We will deploy our capital into this high-conviction earnings play to capture the massive disconnect between operational reality and current depressed valuation.

bear.last: LITE: The bull is buying a falling knife into a binary event with zero margin for error.
